_about: PM-012 CFD release status for the flight model. Labels: docs/08_shooter_spec.md lines 5-6. Every CFD output in this file is PREDICTED (own solver, not validated); earlier text and commit ca68597 called such numbers derived, which was wrong. See cfd/README.md, sections Acceptance and Validation results.
model_use: none: keep the ASSUMED values in data/aero_params.json
solver: route (b): own LBM-LES, cfd/lbm/ (D3Q19, FP16, BGK, Smagorinsky Cs 0.1); FluidX3D not used

acceptance.source: bands pre-registered 2026-10-31 09:32 (commit 208142e) before any run; averaging, lateral-force, run-length and STL conditions added after the review; the torque gate, the S 0 STL rule and the V2 twin-stationarity condition were added at 2026-10-31 13:47 after the second review, before their evaluation
acceptance.V1: smooth sphere, Re 33057, S 0: box-corrected Cd in 0.43-0.50, Cd stationary, u_win(Cd) <= 0.035, T >= 150
acceptance.V2: smooth sphere, Re 33057, S 0.5: Cl in 0.22-0.33, Cl stationary, S 0 twin over the same window with a stationary Cl window, u_win(Cl) + L_twin <= 0.055, T >= 150; with twins of several noise seeds every twin meets this and L_twin is the largest
acceptance.same_configuration: V1 and V2 pass with one collision model, Cs, precision, grid and box; POLLEN runs use it
acceptance.stl_path: an STL sphere at S 0.5 matches the analytic sphere in Cd, Cl and CM at the release grid
acceptance.revox: one POLLEN spin case matches in Cd, Cl and CM at two revox values
acceptance.match_rule: both runs stationary and |diff| <= max(t95 sqrt(se_a^2 + se_b^2), floor); floors Cd 0.01, Cl 0.01, CM 0.001
acceptance.band_on_pollen_values: Cd: X +- (b |X| + u_win); Cl: X +- (b |X| + u_win + L_twin); b = max(|V1 error|, |V2 error vs 0.275|, |change between the two finest grids|), so never below the V1 error

withdrawn.rule: 30 % gate (Cd within 30 % of the reference, 0.317-0.589) and the phrase 'inside the gate'
withdrawn.when_who: written into cfd/README.md in commit 28f95b1 (2026-10-31 10:18) by the AI coding agent that built the solver, 11 minutes after the first D 48 run (Cd 0.699, +54 %) failed the pre-registered band; commit ca68597 (10:32) then called the BGK run (+24 %) inside the gate
withdrawn.why: no reason was recorded: a post-hoc relaxation after a failing result, about as wide as the ASSUMED model range Cd 0.35-0.65, so passing it would add nothing

acceptance.torque_note: the CM part of the STL-path and revox matches waits for the torque gate
acceptance.stl_path_S0: STL sphere vs analytic sphere at S 0, same grid and settings, T >= 150: both Cd windows stationary and |Cd difference| <= max(t95 sqrt(se_a^2 + se_b^2), 0.01); CM, Cy, Cl and L reported, not gated; |CM| of the STL run is the static torque floor F_STL. Written after the run had finished (13:17) and after its Cd and CM had appeared in notes and the review (not blind); replaces the 12:55 text 'match in Cd and Cl'

torque.case: smooth analytic sphere, Re 33057, S 0.5, BGK, FP16, Cs 0.1, u 0.05 (tau 0.50022 at D 48, 0.50029 at D 64, 0.50044 at D 96), T >= 150, release grid and box
torque.CM_ref_label: derived: Ito & Kamijima 2025 Table 5 (LES), Cm 3.17e-3 at SP 0.5 interpolated to Re 33057; CM = 2 Cm with their T = -Cm pi a^3 rho v^2 (Ito & Kamijima 2022 eq. 4, ASSUMED to hold in 2025)
torque.band_label: ASSUMED: +-25 %, the spread to Ito & Kamijima 2022 Table 4 (k-epsilon, CM 0.0047 at Re 33057)
torque.pass: the case, CM in the band, CM stationary, u_win(CM) <= 0.0016
torque.if_fail: no CM or k is released, quoted or matched
torque.pre_registered: 2026-10-31 13:47, before any evaluation under it; the review's D 48 and D 64 CM values were known (not blind)
torque.V0_note: V0 (Stokes Re, FP32, regularized, tau 1.1) is not a production check

acceptance.band_on_CM_and_k: X +- (e_M |X| + u_win) with e_M from the torque gate (not from b); the half-width is never below F_STL for CM and F_STL x kf for k (kf = 0.5 rho v pi R_cfd^4 / (I S))

averaging.window: t* 15 to the end of the run
averaging.batch: max(2 T_int, 5 t*), T_int = max(autocorrelation to first zero, batch-means estimates at 5/10/20 t*)
averaging.uncertainty: u_win = standard deviation of the batch means
averaging.trend: least-squares slope over the whole window x window length
averaging.label: ASSUMED (modelling choices)

V0.case: sphere spinning in still fluid, Stokes regime
V0.label: PREDICTED
V0.note: not a production check: Stokes Re (Re_rot 0.4), FP32, regularized collision, tau 1.1

V1.reason: no finished run meets every condition. The two gate-length runs (T 150, noise seeds 0 and 104729) g48_v1_S0_T150 and g48_v1_S0_T150_seed104729 have box-corrected Cd 0.545 and 0.542, outside 0.43-0.50. The lowest box-corrected Cd, 0.497 (v1_bgk_d94, T 55), is inside the band but not gate length, and its box correction is ASSUMED for BGK

box_factor.label: PREDICTED (regularized D 48, box 8x6x6 / 6x4x4); ASSUMED to transfer to BGK and finer grids
